title: Associate Business Development Executive - Pensions
description:
Associate Business Development Executive - Pensions

Location: Leicester / Hybrid

Salary: Up to £32,000

Contract: Full-Time, Permanent

NJR Recruitment is delighted to be working with a growing financial services business who are looking to appoint an Associate Business Development Executive to join their pensions team in Leicester. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a good understanding of pensions who is looking to develop their career in a commercial, relationship-focused environment. The role provides a structured pathway into a full Business Development Executive position, combining hands-on experience, mentoring, technical development and exposure to clients, advisers and internal stakeholders.

The Role

As an Associate Business Development Executive, you will act as a key link between the Business Development team and operational teams, taking new business cases from initial handover through to operational execution. You will work closely with Business Development Executives, Financial Advisers, clients, technical specialists, compliance and administration teams to ensure cases progress smoothly and efficiently. Alongside your business development responsibilities, you will also support the training and mentoring of the Onboarding Administration Team under the guidance of a BDE or Senior BDE.

Key Responsibilities
- Receiving new business cases from Business Development Executives and managing the conversion process
- Acting as a key point of contact throughout the onboarding journey
- Liaising with clients and Financial Advisers to gather required documentation and clarify technical information
- Reviewing cases to assess complexity and identify potential issues
- Working with technical and administration teams to resolve queries and progress cases
- Ensuring all onboarding requirements are completed, including AML checks, scheme transfers and investment setup
- Working closely with Compliance and Risk to ensure regulatory requirements are met before activation
- Maintaining accurate records of case progress and providing regular management information to the Senior Business Development Executive
- Monitoring outstanding actions and ensuring timely follow-up
- Identifying bottlenecks and suggesting improvements to the onboarding process
- Supporting the wider Business Development team with pipeline development and client engagement
- Developing strong relationships with Financial Advisers, clients and internal stakeholders
- Supporting the training and mentoring of the Onboarding Administration Team

About You

We are looking for someone who is commercially minded, proactive and keen to develop a career within Business Development and financial services. You will ideally have a good understanding of SIPP and SSAS products and be confident communicating with a wide range of stakeholders. You will also have:
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Good organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- A confident and proactive approach
- The ability to build positive relationships with clients, advisers and colleagues
- Good presentation skills
- An analytical mindset with the ability to interpret information and identify key issues
- The ability to manage multiple cases and competing priorities
- A genuine interest in commercial and client-facing work
- A willingness to learn and develop your business development skills

Qualifications & Career Development

The successful candidate will be required to study towards Diploma Level 4 or CII R04, with full training and development support provided. Previous experience in a customer-facing, administrative or sales support role would be advantageous. Experience using CRM systems would also be beneficial, although a willingness to learn is more important.

This role is specifically designed to develop your commercial knowledge, relationship management skills and understanding of the Business Development function.

A key attraction of this role is the structured development pathway into a Business Development Executive position.

What's On Offer?
- Salary up to £32,000
- Hybrid working
- Structured career development pathway
- Mentoring from experienced Business Development professionals
- Training and development support
- Opportunity to progress into a Business Development Executive role
- Competitive bonus structure on completion of training
- Collaborative and supportive team environment

This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious pensions professional who wants to move into a more commercial and client-facing role, with genuine progression and development opportunities.

Apply today via NJR Recruitment or call quoting the reference NJR17046

Please note: Due to a high volume of applications, if your CV does not reflect the essential requirements, or you answer 'no' to key screening questions, we may not be able to contact you.

title: Business Development Executive
company: BPX Electro Mechanical Co Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
As BPX continues to grow, we are looking to strengthen our team and recruit a Business Development Executive to support the ambitious plans at our Leicester branch (LE7 7 NL). We are looking for someone with strong sales experience who possesses the skills needed to identify new business opportunities and lead growth initiatives within the existing portfolio. The ability to build relationships, work in a team, and continually learn will make the difference in this role. If you can bring high energy, initiative, and a technical interest to deliver the best solutions for customers, your career at BPX will fly.

About Us:

For 60 years BPX (part of the RS Group) has built a reputation as the leading independent distributor of factory automation and control components - from computers to connectors, from robots to relays and everything in between. We now employ over 180 people and from our 15 locations throughout the UK & Ireland, we provide a local service to our customers.

Our continued success comes from our passion for technology and commitment to customer service. We are a talented group across our UK and Ireland branch network and work towards our mission for our customers, "help to choose, help to use".

BPX are the strategic partner to market leading brands such as Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, Omron and many more, offering innovative products, solutions and technical support to thousands of customers UK wide.

The main duties will include:

Deliver sales growth through the development of both new and existing businesses within the defined geographical area.

Build trust and develop strong relationships with customers, manufacturers, and colleagues to achieve 'win-win' outcomes for all stakeholders.

Adopt a consultative approach to sales, presenting solutions to customers that deliver value and help solve their industrial control and automation challenges Balance the demands of prospecting for new business, in addition to enhancing relationships and contact points within the existing account portfolio.

Maintain a presence in the BPX branch, staying close to the people and local market.

Support marketing activities such as campaigns and promotions to increase customer awareness of product launches, events, competitions, etc.

Commit to learning, development, and training in both technical and non-technical areas.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

Experience in B2 B sales, ideally with knowledge of the industrial distribution market.

Drive sales growth opportunities through new and existing accounts/partnerships.

Familiar with the market dynamics between manufacturers, distributors, and customers.

Strong relationship builder, communicator, and team player.

Customer-centric, able to identify challenges and present solutions.

Organised and able to prioritise as required.

Committed to build knowledge across industrial control and automation products.

Familiar with CRM systems and able to produce sales reports.

BPX offers great benefits such as:

Minimum of 31 days annual leave including bank holidays (increasing with length of service)

Access to our training and development platform

Friendly and supportive work environment

Dress down Fridays

Access to the Employee Assistance Programme

Recruitment referral bonus

Opportunities for career progression

Cycle 2 Work scheme

Ability to carry forward unused holiday

Option to purchase additional annual leave

Free onsite parking

Emergency loans

BPX remains a financially secure business, offering the chance to work within a happy, friendly company with some wonderful and talented people.

If you like a challenge and believe you are the right person to join our team, please click apply and upload your CV, we look forward to hearing from you!

We reserve the right to close the advert early when a suitable candidate is found.

No Agencies, please

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
We are currently recruiting for an Internal Sales Executive based on the outskirts of Loughborough for an office based and permanent role working Monday to Friday 9am until 5:30pm

Benefits
- Company pension scheme.
- Company sick pay scheme.
- 23 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays.
- Employee discount.
- Free on-site parking.

About the role:

The role combines inbound sales, proactive outbound account management and sales administration, with a primary focus on creating a positive customer experience while supporting business growth.
- Deliver an outstanding customer experience throughout every stage of the sales journey.
- Handle inbound sales calls, understand customer requirements and convert enquiries into sales opportunities.
- Manage the shared sales inbox by responding promptly and professionally to customer enquiries, quotation requests and order updates.
- Make outbound calls to existing and prospective customers to build relationships, follow up quotations, generate new opportunities and promote products, offers and campaigns.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently via telephone and email.
- Prepare, send and follow up quotations to maximise sales opportunities.
- Maintain accurate customer records, sales activity and communication history within the company CRM system.
- Develop a strong understanding of the company's products and services through ongoing training and day-to-day customer interactions.
- Work closely with colleagues across all departments to support a smooth customer journey and consistently high service standards.
- Support the wider Sales Team with administrative and operational tasks as required.

About You
- Enthusiastic, organised and confident communicator, comfortable engaging with customers by phone and email.
- Able to build rapport quickly and committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience.
- Positive, proactive and solutions-focused, with the confidence to identify and pursue sales opportunities.
- Previous experience in internal sales, sales support, account management or another customer-focused sales role.
- Experience making outbound sales calls and supporting customer account development.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, supported by strong customer service abilities.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Outlook; experience using a CRM system would be advantageous.
- Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise workload, manage multiple tasks and work effectively as part of a team.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, delivering excellent customer service and helping customers find the right solutions. To be considered please apply! For further information contact Rebecca on (phone number removed)
S14

About Us

We are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive community. In line with our Diversity and Inclusion policy, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability. As a Disability Confident Employer, and part of the Nicholas Associates Group, we are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities, and we're happy to discuss flexible working options.

We are committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients. If you choose to apply, your information will be processed in accordance with the Nicholas Associates Group of companies Privacy Notice.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Sales Coordinator - Part Time

Fancy a part-time role where no two days look the same, hours built around you, and your work helping to win new business? One hire really does make a difference at a business this size.

Salary: £28,000 -£32,000

Permanent

Hinckley

22.5 Hours Per Week

About the role

JML Contractors Ltd is a growing mechanical and electrical contractor, delivering projects and maintenance work across the UK. Services span electrical installations, air conditioning, EV charging infrastructure and renewable energy solutions, and this role sits at the centre of the business's growth.

You'll work closely with the management team to identify new opportunities, look after existing clients, and keep quotes and tenders on track from first enquiry through to award. Your work feeds directly into the reports management use to track pipeline and conversion.

What's in it for you
- Hours built around you, with flexibility on days and start and finish times
- A varied role spanning business development, client relationships and tender management
- Genuine career progression as JML continues to grow
- A small, close-knit team where your work is noticed

What you'll do

You'll:
- Identify and research new business opportunities and prospective clients
- Contact prospective clients to introduce JML's services and build relationships
- Maintain regular contact with existing clients, including after-sales follow-up calls
- Gather customer feedback and promote JML's wider range of services
- Maintain the company's lead, quote and tender register
- Track quotations and tenders from enquiry through to award, following up with customers

What you'll need (essential)
- Proven experience in business development, sales support, account management, customer service or tender administration
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook
- Excellent communication skills with both customers and internal colleagues
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to push tenders through the process

Nice to have
- Experience within construction, engineering, M&E, electrical, mechanical or facilities management
- Experience managing quotations, tenders or a sales pipeline
- Familiarity with CRM systems

Working arrangements

hours a week, worked across days that suit you, with the exact pattern agreed at interview. Based on-site at JML's Hinckley office.

How to apply

If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to hear from you. Click apply and send over your CV.

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Sales Account Manager
(Education)
£25,000 - £30,000 Commission
Full time, Permanent
Leicester, Hybrid (3 days in office)

Are you currently working in education, perhaps in sales, business support or operations? Would you like to build a career in sales without cold calling, while increasing your earning potential through uncapped commission?

We are working with an established software business with a strong presence in the education sector. Following continued growth, they are looking for someone with an education background to join their successful team.

You will be confident building relationships, asking the right questions and moving conversations forward. You might already work in education sales, or have gained experience discussing requirements, presenting solutions or supporting buying decisions as part of a wider role.

Above all, you will understand how schools and trusts operate, recognise that their needs differ and enjoy helping them find a solution that works for them.

The role
- Following up on inbound enquiries by phone and email
- Building rapport with school and trust contacts to understand their needs
- Identifying decision makers, purchasing processes and potential barriers
- Discussing budgets, priorities, existing contracts and renewal dates
- Booking qualified meetings and providing clear handover notes to senior Sales colleagues
- Nurturing prospects who are interested but aren t ready to move forward
- Generating new opportunities through proactive calls, emails and follow-up
- Maintaining clear, accurate records in the CRM

The candidate
- Experience in the education sector, either within a school or trust, or through a business selling to this sector
- Great understanding of school priorities, budget requirements and decision-making
- Proactive approach and driven mindset to keep conversations moving
- Strong organisation skills and consistent follow-through
- Motivated to work towards targets and develop a career in software sales

In return
- £25,000 - £30,000 per annum commission
- Hybrid working, including 2 days from home
- The opportunity to join an established software business
- Further development opportunities for a career in EdTech Sales

Are you ready for your next step in EdTech Sales? Click Apply today!

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Title: Senior Account Executive
Location: Leicester
Salary: Negotiable + benefits

Job Purpose

We are currently looking for a Senior Account Executive / Private Client Executive to be based out of our welcoming and professional Leicester office.

This position will manage and develop a portfolio of HNW and Private Client customers, delivering exceptional customer service, strong retention performance, and sustainable growth through new business and account development.

The role requires a consultative approach, ensuring clients receive tailored insurance solutions that meet their individual circumstances and evolving insurance needs.

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management
- Manage and retain an allocated portfolio of private clients.
- Conduct thorough annual client reviews and identify any changes in circumstances, exposures, or insurance requirements.
- Develop and maintain strong long-term relationships with clients, introducers, insurers and internal stakeholders.
- Deliver a highly personalised and professional service consistent with the expectations of HNW clients.

Insurance & Technical Responsibilities
- Obtain and negotiate quotations from insurers and recommend the most suitable cover solutions.
- Ensure all renewals are invited, reviewed and completed within regulatory and business timescales.
- Process new business, renewals, mid-term adjustments and other policy changes accurately.
- Identify gaps in cover and proactively recommend suitable protection solutions.
- Review all policy documentation for accuracy before issue.
- Maintain accurate client records and ensure all communications are appropriately documented.
- Support clients through the claims process and liaise with insurers as required.

Business Development
- Achieve agreed retention, income and new business targets.
- Generate opportunities through referrals, networking and existing client relationships.
- Identify opportunities to cross-sell and upsell appropriate products and services.
- Support branch and team growth strategies through proactive client engagement.

Compliance & Operational Excellence
- Ensure all activities are conducted in line with FCA regulations, Consumer Duty requirements and company procedures.
- Deliver positive customer outcomes and maintain high standards of file quality and record keeping.
- Support credit control activities and assist in timely collection of premiums.
- Complete all mandatory learning, training and CPD requirements.

The Rewards:
- A negotiable basic salary + all the normal benefits (25 days holiday + Bank Holidays, Pension, Death in Service etc.)
- Access to both Flexible benefits and our annual share save scheme (15% discount on BRO shares (post probation).
- Full support for your professional development (including fully funded qualifications)

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Experience within Private Client, HNW or Personal Lines Insurance.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
- High attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality outcomes.
- Competent user of insurance systems, insurer portals and Microsoft Office applications.
- Understanding of FCA regulations and customer outcome requirements.

Desirable
- Cert CII qualified or working towards qualification.
- Experience dealing with complex High Net Worth risks.
- Existing Acturis knowledge.
